questions.stem:
(i) A spherical surface of radius of curvature R separates two media of refractive indices \(\mathrm{n_1}\) and \(\mathrm{n_2}\). questions.stem:

(ii) The distance of a far off point on the equatorial plane of an electric dipole is halved. How will the electric field be affected for the dipole ?

Use this law to obtain an expression for the magnetic field at the centre of a circular loop of radius 'a' and carrying a current 'I'. (ii) An electron is revolving around the nucleus in a circular orbit with a speed of \(10^{7}\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\). If the radius of the orbit is \(10^{-10}\) m, find the current constituted by the revolving electron in the orbit.
